newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin approves Russia energy minister resignation.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin approves Russia energy minister resignation.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin approved the resignation of Pyotr Rodionov from the post of Fuel and Energy Minister, presidential spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky said on Tuesday.
The decision was taken during a meeting on Tuesday between Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin and Yeltsin, Yastrzhembsky told a news briefing.
Rodionov handed in his resignation last week, but his replacement has yet to be confirmed.

At an industry conference on Tuesday Rodionov said the only candidate he was aware of was Alexander Samusev, vice-president of Rosprom-YUKOS and a former deputy minister in the Fuel and Energy and Finance Ministries.
But Samusev later said he had declined an offer of the post by the government for health reasons.
